title: Trial by Trace: Benchmarking AI Agent Harnesses for Reliability and Failure Attribution
title_zh: Trace Trial：面向可靠性与失败归因的AI智能体框架基准测试

paragraphs.en: LLM agents are increasingly used to solve real-world problems, and their effectiveness depends on both the underlying models and the harnesses that support their operation. However, most existing benchmarks focus on model capabilities and overall agent performance, with limited attention to the evaluation of agent harnesses. To address this gap, we introduce TraceTrial-Bench , which organizes harness reliability into seven components covering context, execution, governance, lifecycle, observability, tools, and verification. We construct 95 expert-level, mechanism-oriented tasks with executable or state-based ground truth to support semantically equivalent comparisons while preserving the native behavior of each harness. We design a Trajectory Tracing (TT) module to capture agent execution traces and introduce a two-layer evaluation framework that separately assesses agent performance and harness reliability. In addition, we design a Multi-source Evidence Acquisition (MEA) module to provide evidence from the agent context, harness, and execution environment for LLM-based evaluation, and develop a Failure Attribution (FA) module that uses explicit mechanism chains to support attribution at the run level. Across 4 harnesses, 9 models, and 95 tasks, our evaluation of 3,420 runs yields macro-averaged harness scores ranging from 59.8% to 72.0%, while 31.1% of runs achieve task success despite failing at least one harness criterion. TraceTrial-Bench provides an auditable and reproducible foundation for comparing agent harnesses, diagnosing their failures, and studying how harness design interacts with model behavior.

paragraphs.en: Large language models have evolved from systems that primarily generate text into the foundation of AI agents that can carry out complex, multi-step tasks ( wang2024survey ; yao2022react ; agashe2025agent ) . By using tools, executing commands, modifying files, and interacting with external environments, these agents can translate user goals into concrete actions and observable outcomes ( schick2023toolformer ; yang2024swe ; wang2025openhands ) . However, an AI agent relies on more than its underlying model ( sumers2023cognitive ) . Its behavior also depends on system instructions, context management, available tools, execution environments, persistent state, lifecycle controls, and safety mechanisms ( packer2023memgpt ; wu2023autogen ; mei2024aios ) . As a result, the same model can behave differently when deployed through different system configurations. The agent harness connects the model to these surrounding components and determines what information reaches the model, which actions it can take, and how tool results, errors, and state changes are presented. Agent performance should therefore be understood as a property of the complete system, with the harness treated as a distinct and reliability-critical component ( li2026agent ; ning2026code ) .

paragraphs.en: Most existing agent benchmarks evaluate task completion through final answers, test results, or environment states ( merrill2026terminal ; deng2025swe ; barres2025tau ) . These measures capture the combined effects of the model and its harness, but provide limited insight into whether specific harness mechanisms function reliably. As illustrated in Figure 1 , task success may conceal lost context, misleading tool results, or lifecycle violations, while task failure can occur despite faithful harness execution. Even with the model held fixed, outcome-level comparisons alone cannot identify which harness behaviors account for the observed differences ( barke2026agentrx ; liu2026auditing ) . Recent studies have begun to examine harness configuration effects and safety, motivating complementary evaluation of individual harness mechanisms ( yao2026harness ; bai2026harnessrisk ) . Such evaluation requires tasks that exercise explicit harness obligations, evidence that reveals whether those obligations were fulfilled, and separate assessments of harness behavior and task outcomes.

paragraphs.en: Therefore, we introduce TraceTrial-Bench , a mechanism-oriented benchmark that treats the native agent harness as the system under test. It assesses harness behavior through auditable execution traces and external environment states. Building on an existing harness taxonomy ( li2026agent ) , we organize reliability into seven components: context, execution, governance, lifecycle, observability, tools, and verification. We construct 95 tasks that exercise specific harness mechanisms through practical workflows, pairing explicit behavioral requirements with agent deliverables and executable or state-based ground truth. Cross-harness adapters preserve common task objectives and evaluation criteria while retaining each harness’s native interfaces and execution behavior. Evaluating the same model–task combinations across harnesses provides a basis for comparing their overall reliability and identifying weaknesses in individual components.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们提出 TraceTrial-Bench，一个以机制为导向的基准，它将原生的智能体（agent）运行框架作为被测系统。 它通过可审计的执行轨迹和外部环境状态来评估运行框架的行为。 在现有的运行框架分类体系（li2026agent）基础上，我们将可靠性组织为七个组成部分：上下文、执行、治理、生命周期、可观测性、工具和验证。 我们构建了 95 个任务，通过实际工作流来测试特定的运行框架机制，将明确的行为要求与智能体的交付物以及可执行的或基于状态的基准真值相配对。 跨运行框架的适配器在保留每个运行框架原生接口和执行行为的同时，保持了统一的任务目标和评估标准。 在不同运行框架上评估相同的模型–任务组合，为比较它们的整体可靠性并识别各个组成部分中的薄弱环节提供了依据。

paragraphs.en: Specifically, the Trajectory Tracing (TT) module reconstructs native execution records in a shared Trace Intermediate Representation (Trace IR) while preserving their provenance. A Multi-source Evidence Acquisition (MEA) module combines these records with workspace artifacts and authoritative environment state to assemble criterion-specific evidence. After apparatus integrity checks, the two-layer evaluation framework separately assesses agent task performance and harness reliability. The Failure Attribution (FA) module then connects failed harness and agent criteria through predefined mechanism chains, with further evidence review required to distinguish activated candidate links from validated failure propagation. Across four harnesses, nine models, and 95 tasks, we evaluate 3,420 selected executions. Task success and harness-criterion satisfaction yield different harness rankings, and 31.1% of runs achieve task success despite failing at least one harness criterion. These findings show how separate assessments of task outcomes and harness behavior expose reliability differences that outcome-only evaluation can overlook.

paragraphs.en: We construct TraceTrial-Bench, a 95-task benchmark covering seven reliability components while preserving native harness behavior in cross-harness comparisons.

paragraphs.en: We develop a two-layer evaluation framework combining TT, MEA, and Trace IR to separately assess agent performance and harness reliability.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开发了一个两层评估框架，结合 TT、MEA 和 Trace IR，分别评估智能体的表现与测试脚手架的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: We introduce failure attribution through explicit mechanism chains, distinguishing candidate links from failure propagation validated through evidence review.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过显式机制链引入故障归因，区分候选链接与经证据审查验证的故障传播。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate four harnesses and nine models across 3,420 selected executions and provide tasks, configurations, traces, and verdicts for reproducible analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 3,420 次选定的执行中评估了四个 harness 与九个模型，并提供任务、配置、轨迹和判定结果，以支持可复现的分析。

paragraphs.en: A modern agent combines a model’s decisions with a harness that manages repeated interaction with tools and the environment ( wei2026agentic ; zhong2026ai ) . We use the abstraction
paragraphs.zh: 一个现代的智能体将模型的决策与管理其与工具和环境反复交互的框架结合在一起（ wei2026agentic ； zhong2026ai ）。我们使用这一抽象

paragraphs.en: The model interprets available information and selects actions. The harness constructs context, exposes tool interfaces, transports calls and results, maintains persistent state, and enforces execution and permission controls. Tool calls, workspace changes, and output artifacts record the effects of this interaction. Task performance therefore depends on both model decisions and the way those decisions are supported by the harness.
paragraphs.zh: 模型解释可用信息并选择动作。 智能体运行框架（harness）负责构建上下文、暴露工具接口、传输调用与结果、维护持久化状态，并执行执行控制与权限控制。 工具调用、工作区变更和输出产物记录了这次交互的效果。 因此，任务表现既取决于模型的决策，也取决于运行框架（harness）支持这些决策的方式。

paragraphs.en: A scaffold usually describes prompts, workflows, and action strategies built around the model, while a runtime supplies processes, file systems, and computing resources. Our harness boundary includes their orchestration and control functions. External tool implementations, task environments, output artifacts, evaluators, and measurement apparatus remain outside that boundary. This separation is necessary when deciding whether an observation concerns a harness obligation, an Agent decision, or a failure of the measurement process.
paragraphs.zh: 脚手架通常描述围绕模型构建的提示、工作流和行动策略，而运行时则提供进程、文件系统和计算资源。 我们的测试框架边界包含其编排与控制功能。 外部工具实现、任务环境、输出产物、评估器和测量装置都保留在该边界之外。 在判断某条观察结果涉及的是测试框架的义务、智能体的决策，还是测量过程的失败时，这种区分是必要的。

paragraphs.en: Harness functions affect several parts of an execution. Execution and lifecycle controls communicate command outcomes, manage long-running work, and preserve continuity across sessions and delegated tasks ( ma2026longhorizon ) . paragraphs.en: Harness reliability concerns faithful information delivery and execution semantics. It does not guarantee task success: a model can make an incorrect decision after receiving accurate information. Conversely, a correct final artifact can coexist with an incomplete result channel, a lost state transition, or a violated interaction requirement. Evaluating only the final deliverable would combine these different situations into a single outcome.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体运行框架的可靠性关注的是忠实的信息传递与执行语义。 它并不保证任务成功：模型在接收到准确信息后仍可能做出错误的决策。 反过来，正确的最终产物也可能与不完整的结果通道、丢失的状态转换或被违反的交互要求并存。 只评估最终交付物会把这几种不同的情况合并为单一结果。

paragraphs.en: TraceTrial-Bench therefore assigns separate criteria to Agent outcomes and Harness obligations. The Agent layer checks required actions, task compliance, and final deliverables against authoritative state. The Harness layer checks whether the native system fulfilled the information and execution obligations exercised by the task. The seven-component taxonomy in Section 3.2.1 translates these responsibilities into observable properties.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，TraceTrial-Bench 为智能体结果和测试框架义务分别设定了独立的评判标准。 智能体层对照权威状态检查所需操作、任务合规性以及最终交付物。 测试框架层检查原生系统是否履行了任务所行使的信息义务和执行义务。 第 3.2.1 节中的七组件分类法将这些职责转化为可观察的属性。

paragraphs.en: An external result, a model-facing tool return, a native session record, and a normalized event are related observations, but they need not contain the same information. Environment state establishes what occurred. Changed artifacts identify the persisted deliverable, and native model-facing records establish what the model could observe. Provider-request evidence supports only the captured structured tool declarations, not uncaptured request bodies. Evidence from one boundary cannot automatically substitute for evidence from another.

paragraphs.en: We distinguish four levels of claim. A criterion verdict records satisfaction under the selected evidence. Confirming a Harness defect additionally requires reconciliation with the authoritative sources for that criterion. An activated candidate link records failed endpoints and a matching predeclared condition. Validating propagation further requires observable intermediate distortion, supported event order, and consideration of competing explanations. Apparatus failure is a measurement limitation rather than a Harness defect. These distinctions govern the scoring and attribution protocol developed next.
paragraphs.zh: 我们区分四个主张层级。 准则判定记录在所选证据下的满足情况。 确认框架缺陷还需要与该准则的权威来源进行核对。 已激活的候选链接记录失败的端点以及匹配的预先声明条件。 进一步验证传播还需要可观测的中间畸变、受支持的事件顺序，以及对竞争性解释的考量。 装置故障是测量局限，而非框架缺陷。 这些区别将支配接下来制定的评分与归因规程。

paragraphs.en: TraceTrial-Bench evaluates an agent harness as a system, rather than treating it as a transparent wrapper around a model (Figure 2 ). The benchmark asks three distinct questions for every admitted run: (i) did the agent produce the required artifacts and actions, (ii) did the native harness preserve the information, execution semantics, and lifecycle behavior required by the task, and (iii) is an observed agent-side failure consistent with a predeclared propagation mechanism from a Harness-side criterion failure? The third question is addressed by automatically activating criterion-level candidate links when the corresponding Harness and Agent criteria both fail and the predeclared activation conditions are satisfied.
paragraphs.zh: TraceTrial-Bench 将智能体框架作为一个系统来评估，而不是把它视为模型周围的透明封装层（图 2）。 该基准针对每个被采纳的运行提出三个不同的问题：(i) 智能体是否产出了所需的工件与动作，(ii) 原生框架是否保留了任务所需的信息、执行语义与生命周期行为，(iii) 观察到的智能体侧失败是否与某个框架侧判据失败预先声明的传播机制相一致？ 第三个问题通过如下方式解决：当对应的框架判据与智能体判据同时失败且预先声明的激活条件得到满足时，自动激活判据级别的候选链接。

paragraphs.en: This chapter describes the implemented measurement pipeline for the released runs. It combines apparatus admission, layer-specific Agent and Harness scoring, provenance-preserving trace reconstruction, deterministic criterion-specific evidence selection, and criterion-level candidate-mechanism linking. Run-level outputs summarize criterion verdicts and automatically activated candidate links. These outputs support evidence-based failure analysis, while confirming Harness defects or failure propagation requires additional validation beyond automated scoring.
paragraphs.zh: 本章介绍已发布运行的测量流水线的实现。 该流水线结合了仪器准入、针对特定层的智能体（Agent）与测试框架（Harness）评分、保留来源的轨迹重建、确定性的按判据选择证据，以及判据层面的候选机制关联。 运行级输出汇总了各判据的判定结果以及自动激活的候选关联。 这些输出支持基于证据的失败分析，而确认测试框架缺陷或失败传播则需要超出自动评分的额外验证。

paragraphs.en: We capitalize Harness layer and Agent layer when referring to the two score sheets, and use Judge for the configured semantic grader. We distinguish four claim levels. A criterion verdict records whether the selected evidence satisfies a declared scoring condition. A confirmed Harness defect additionally reconciles a failed Harness criterion with the question-specific authoritative source. An activated candidate mechanism link records that a predeclared Harness–Agent endpoint pair and its activation condition match the run. A validated propagation claim additionally requires confirmation of both endpoint verdicts and manual review of event order, an observable intermediate distortion, and plausible competing explanations. This hierarchy keeps operational scores and propagation claims auditable without treating an internal runtime label as a causal conclusion.
paragraphs.zh: 在提及这两份评分表时，我们将 Harness 层和智能体层首字母大写，并用 Judge 指代所配置的语义评分器。 我们区分四个断言层级。 准则判定记录所选证据是否满足已声明的评分条件。 已确认的 Harness 缺陷还会将失败的 Harness 准则与针对该问题的权威来源进行核对。 已激活的候选机制链接记录预声明的 Harness–智能体端点对及其激活条件与本次运行相匹配。 已验证的传播断言还要求确认两个端点的判定，并对事件顺序、可观察到的中间失真以及可能的竞争性解释进行人工审查。 这一层级结构使运营评分和传播断言保持可审计性，而无需将内部运行时标签视为因果结论。

paragraphs.en: A nominal “tool result” may have several non-equivalent representations: the tool or process produces an external result; the harness may transform it; the model receives a model-facing payload; a native session archive records some representation; and the evaluator observes a normalized event. TraceTrial- Bench consequently uses question-specific authorities. Environment or simulator state is authoritative for what actually happened, changed artifacts are authoritative for final persisted artifact state, provider-request evidence is authoritative only for the structured tool declarations it retained, and a native model-facing result is authoritative for what the model could observe.
paragraphs.zh: 名义上的「工具结果」可能有多种不等价的表示形式：工具或进程产生一个外部结果；运行框架可能会对其进行转换；模型接收到面向模型的载荷；原生会话归档记录某种表示；而评估器观测到的是一个规范化的事件。 因此 TraceTrial-Bench 采用针对具体问题的权威来源。 环境或模拟器状态对于实际发生的事情具有权威性，变更后的产物对于最终持久化的产物状态具有权威性，提供方请求证据仅对其保留的结构化工具声明具有权威性，而面向模型的原生结果对于模型能够观察到什么具有权威性。

paragraphs.en: The formal evaluation organizes Harness reliability into seven top-level dimensions: Context ( C ), Execution ( E ), Governance ( G ), Lifecycle ( L ), Observability ( O ), Tools ( T ), and Verification ( V ) ( li2026agent ) . The dimensions are defined by the Harness obligation under test rather than by the application scenario in which it is exercised. Figure 4 shows the property distribution (left) and summarizes the scope of each dimension and its task coverage in the 95-task evaluation population (right).
paragraphs.zh: 该正式评估将 Harness 可靠性划分为七个顶层维度：上下文（C）、执行（E）、治理（G）、生命周期（L）、可观测性（O）、工具（T）与验证（V）（li2026agent）。 这些维度依据被测试的 Harness 义务来定义，而不是依据其所应用的应用场景来定义。 图 4 展示了属性分布（左），并总结了每个维度的范围及其在 95 个任务评估总体中的任务覆盖情况（右）。

paragraphs.en: Cross-cutting behaviors are assigned according to the property being tested. For example, state isolation is evaluated under Context when the question is whether information crosses a session boundary, whereas child-agent completion is evaluated under Lifecycle when the question concerns creation, delivery, or termination. A mechanism is included only when its trigger, expected behavior, relevant observation boundary, and verdict conditions can be specified before execution. Coverage is then tracked separately for task assignment, native capability availability, mechanism activation, and evidence sufficiency. Integrity of the measurement apparatus is assessed by the admission gate and is therefore outside the seven-dimension taxonomy.
paragraphs.zh: 横切行为根据被测试的属性进行分配。 例如，当问题涉及信息是否跨越会话边界时，状态隔离在 Context 下评估；而当问题涉及创建、交付或终止时，子智能体完成情况在 Lifecycle 下评估。 只有当其触发条件、预期行为、相关观察边界和判定条件能够在执行前被明确指定时，某个机制才会被纳入。 覆盖率随后分别针对任务分配、原生能力可用性、机制激活和证据充分性进行跟踪。 测量装置的完整性由准入门评估，因此不属于七维分类法的一部分。

The scenario then exercises that mechanism through ordinary domain work. Each task pairs Harness-layer criteria with Agent-layer deliverables and uses deterministic state or artifact checks wherever an oracle is available.

Private simulator state and persisted baseline snapshots remain outside the Agent’s writable workspace. Review checks prompt solvability, mechanism reachability within budget, verifier agreement with task truth, hidden leakage, and equivalent domain semantics across eligible harnesses. The resulting 95-task population is the formal evaluation set.

paragraphs.en: The release includes 46 single-turn, 45 fixed multi-turn, and 4 simulator-driven tasks. Task triggers include oversized outputs requiring recovery, nonzero exits paired with success-shaped artifacts, pending jobs, facts crossing session boundaries, and private values available only through an interaction channel. These conditions make the obligation observable while retaining a practical task and an independent truth anchor.
paragraphs.zh: 本次发布包含 46 个单轮任务、45 个固定多轮任务和 4 个由模拟器驱动的任务。 任务触发条件包括：需要恢复的超大输出、与看似成功的产物同时出现的非零退出码、待处理的作业、跨会话边界传递的事实，以及仅能通过交互渠道获取的私有值。 这些条件使义务可被观察，同时保留了实用性任务和独立的事实依据（truth anchor）。

paragraphs.en: The release evaluates Codex, Claude Code, OpenClaw, and DeepSeek Harness through source-specific adapters. The runner freezes the task revision, harness adapter, requested and resolved model, reasoning setting, timeout, container image, judge model, and resource budgets. Each adapter launches the native harness and translates its observable records without replacing native prompt construction, tool transport, context policy, permissions, or session behavior. The task contract and oracle remain fixed while each harness retains its native execution strategy.
paragraphs.zh: 该发布版本通过针对各源码的适配器对 Codex、Claude Code、OpenClaw 和 DeepSeek Harness 进行评估。 运行器会固定任务修订版本、harness 适配器、请求的模型与解析后的模型、推理设置、超时时间、容器镜像、评审模型以及资源预算。 每个适配器启动原生的 harness 并转换其可观察记录，而不会替换原生的提示词构建、工具传输、上下文策略、权限或会话行为。 任务契约与 oracle 保持固定，同时每个 harness 保留其原生执行策略。

An unavailable named tool is not automatically a defect if the native harness supplies an equivalent usable path. If an adapter cannot preserve the task’s domain semantics or required evidence, the corresponding comparison is non-comparable under the prospective protocol. The current experiment’s full-grid inclusion policy is stated separately in Section 4.3 .

paragraphs.en: Native Harnesses expose different observability interfaces, so trace acquisition is implemented through source-specific adapters. The Codex adapter reads its JSON event stream. The Claude Code adapter combines stream-json output with the session record. The OpenClaw adapter reads local or gateway-backed JSON output together with session JSONL. The DeepSeek Harness adapter consumes its persistent JSON-RPC notification stream. Despite these interface differences, the archival policy is uniform. When a native session or notification archive is available, the runner stores a redacted copy and its digest in the run archive. Valid records that cannot be normalized are preserved as provenance-tagged raw stdout or stderr events rather than discarded.
paragraphs.zh: 各原生 Harness 暴露的可观测性接口不同，因此追踪获取通过针对特定来源的适配器实现。 Codex 适配器读取其 JSON 事件流。 Claude Code 适配器将 stream-json 输出与会话记录相结合。 OpenClaw 适配器读取本地或网关支持的 JSON 输出以及会话 JSONL。 DeepSeek Harness 适配器消费其持久化的 JSON-RPC 通知流。 尽管存在这些接口差异，归档策略是统一的。 当原生会话或通知归档可用时，运行器会在运行归档中存储一份脱敏副本及其摘要。 无法规范化但有效的记录会被保留为带有溯源标签的原始 stdout 或 stderr 事件，而不是被丢弃。

paragraphs.en: To support comparison across Harnesses, the adapters map native observations to a common event schema while retaining their source records. The resulting archive is a JSON array ordered by a contiguous seq index. Each event has a common envelope comprising schema_version , seq , timestamp , run_id , and event_type . Optional type-specific fields are populated only when the native source exposes them. For tool interactions, tool_call records the requested action and tool_result records its correlated return. When available, the return preserves typed error status, integer exit code, duration, truncation status, and omitted size. The parsed source record remains in raw_event , allowing the normalization to be audited against the native observation.
paragraphs.zh: 为了支持跨 Harness 的比较，适配器将原生观测映射到统一的事件模式，同时保留其原始记录。 生成的归档是一个按连续 seq 索引排序的 JSON 数组。 每个事件都有一个共同的信封，包含 schema_version、seq、timestamp、run_id 和 event_type。 可选的类型特定字段仅当原生来源提供时才会填充。 对于工具交互，tool_call 记录请求的操作，tool_result 记录其关联的返回。 在可用的情况下，返回会保留类型化的错误状态、整数退出码、持续时间、截断状态以及被省略的大小。 解析后的原始记录保留在 raw_event 中，使得归一化过程可以对照原生观测进行审计。

paragraphs.en: Reliable reconstruction requires distinguishing event linkage from event order. TraceTrial-Bench therefore associates each tool result with its call using the Harness’s native call identifier whenever one is available. Ambiguous observations—including unmatched, delayed, and duplicate records—remain explicitly unlinked rather than being paired heuristically. In multi-agent runs, principal and parent-principal identifiers record the acting agent and its immediate lineage, while native session and turn identifiers retain boundaries exported by the Harness. The tracer organizes events into a unified sequence for consistent analysis while retaining native timestamps and the original ordering within each source. Together, these fields support analysis of execution lineage and concurrent interleavings when the corresponding native metadata is available.
paragraphs.zh: 可靠的重构需要区分事件关联与事件顺序。 因此，TraceTrial-Bench 在原生调用标识符可用时，利用 Harness 的原生调用标识符将每个工具结果与其调用关联起来。 含糊的观测——包括未匹配、延迟和重复的记录——保持显式未关联状态，而不是通过启发式方法进行配对。 在多智能体运行中，主体（principal）和父主体（parent-principal）标识符记录执行动作的智能体及其直接血缘关系，而原生会话和轮次标识符保留由 Harness 导出的边界。 该追踪器将事件组织成统一序列以便进行一致性分析，同时保留原生时间戳以及每个源内部的原有顺序。 在相应的原生元数据可用时，这些字段共同支持对执行血缘和并发交错的 分析。

paragraphs.en: Claims about tool availability should be grounded in the interface submitted at the provider boundary rather than inferred from static Harness configuration. The runner-side recorder therefore inspects each provider request transiently and extracts structured tools or functions declarations. The archive retains normalized declaration metadata—names, descriptions, input schemas, request order, path, upstream status, timing, and usage—but excludes full request bodies and authorization material. A captured inventory is treated as authoritative for a request only when the request succeeds and the declaration channel is present, structurally valid, and complete. The resulting record establishes the structured tool surface submitted by the Harness at the captured request boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 关于工具可用性的声明应基于在提供商边界提交的接口，而非从静态 Harness 配置推断。 因此，运行器侧的记录器会瞬时检查每个提供商请求，并提取结构化的 tools 或 functions 声明。 归档保留规范化的声明元数据——名称、描述、输入模式、请求顺序、路径、上游状态、时序与用量——但不包含完整请求体和授权材料。 只有当请求成功且声明通道存在、结构有效且完整时，捕获的工具清单才被视为该请求的权威记录。 生成的记录确立了 Harness 在捕获的请求边界处提交的结构化工具面。

paragraphs.en: Every semantic rubric declares eligible event types, fields, literal matching conditions, and a maximum number of returned records. The finder records the matched fields and keywords, making the retrieval contract deterministic and inspectable. Agent rubrics select changed artifacts relative to the persisted baseline and may add supporting trajectory records. Harness rubrics select trajectory and probe evidence, with completed Agent verdicts supplied separately as downstream context. Digest-validated execution and security probes carry an explicit provenance tag, so apparatus observations remain distinguishable from native harness events.
paragraphs.zh: 每条语义评分规则声明可用的事件类型、字段、字面匹配条件以及返回记录的最大数量。 查找器记录匹配的字段和关键词，使检索契约具有确定性和可检查性。 智能体评分规则根据持久化的基线选择发生变化的制品，并可添加辅助性轨迹记录。 测试框架评分规则选择轨迹和探针证据，已完成的智能体裁定作为下游上下文单独提供。 经摘要验证的执行和安全探针带有明确的来源标签，因此装置观测结果仍可与原生测试框架事件区分开来。

paragraphs.en: Event and summary paths must resolve to regular files inside the run’s archived artifact tree and be covered by the archive manifest. Native archives and probe evidence are digest-bound. Task baselines are copied into a private scoring-input area and checked before artifact comparison. Known credentials are redacted recursively by the event writer, provider request bodies are not persisted, and authorization headers are excluded. Together these controls provide software-level path containment, provenance binding, and secret minimization under the benchmark release policy.

paragraphs.en: Evaluation distinguishes criteria that can be decided by a task-specific verifier from those that require semantic interpretation. Each task therefore defines separate Harness- and Agent-layer score sheets, and designates every criterion as either a deterministic rule or a semantic rubric. Before any Judge call, the deterministic outputs are checked against the declared criterion identifiers and fixed. This preserves objective task checks while restricting semantic judgment to criteria for which a deterministic oracle is not available.
paragraphs.zh: 评估将可由任务特定验证器判定的标准与需要语义解读的标准区分开来。 因此，每个任务定义了独立的 Harness 层与智能体层评分表，并将每项标准指定为确定性规则或语义评分准则。 在任何裁判调用之前，确定性输出会对照声明的标准标识符进行检查并固定。 这在保留客观任务检查的同时，将语义评判限制在没有可用确定性 oracle 的标准上。

paragraphs.en: Semantic criteria are evaluated individually from their criterion-specific evidence packets. Agent rubrics are evaluated first, using changed artifacts as primary evidence. Once the complete Agent-layer result has been fixed, Harness rubrics are evaluated from trajectory and probe evidence. Agent verdicts are provided only as downstream context: they may describe the impact observed in the run, but they are not evidence that a Harness criterion failed. For every semantic criterion, the archive retains the matched packet together with the Judge prompt, response, parsed score, and rationale. If a required selector returns no evidence, the current implementation assigns zero and explicitly records the empty selection. This indicates that satisfaction was not established under the declared evidence contract and does not independently prove a Harness defect.

paragraphs.en: We compare four native agent Harnesses over a fully populated matrix of 95 tasks and nine model configurations. Each cell contains one selected execution and its final archived evaluation. The experiment asks whether outcome quality and Harness-criterion satisfaction vary together when the model and task population are held fixed. This section defines the data freeze and analysis protocol. Section 5 reports the results.

paragraphs.en: The evaluated Harnesses are Claude Code, Codex, DeepSeek Harness, and OpenClaw. Source-specific adapters provision the task and archive native evidence while retaining each Harness’s execution and tool-use interfaces. paragraphs.en: There are 855 cells per Harness and 380 per model. The unit of analysis is the root task–model–Harness run directory in outputs/traces . Nested result.json files emitted by tools or simulators are not additional experimental runs. Every selected cell has a final combined_score.json , and no model block is pending and no missing score is imputed. The archive contains selected outcomes, including replacement executions from earlier recovery, rather than independent repetitions per cell. We therefore describe the observed matrix and do not estimate within-cell repeatability.

paragraphs.en: Resource columns report mean recorded usage per run: input, output, and total Tokens in thousands, and estimated Agent cost in USD. We apply the same model-specific prices published on the providers’ official websites across all Harnesses. Input cost partitions ordinary input, cache reads, and cache writes using the available counters. Unspecified cache components use the ordinary input rate. Output cost includes recorded reasoning Tokens without counting them again. Total cost is input plus output cost, averaged over runs with valid recorded usage. These are standardized Token-cost estimates, not historical invoices. Judge calls, discarded executions, payment fees, storage, and tool charges are outside their scope.
paragraphs.zh: 资源列报告每次运行记录的平均用量：输入、输出和总计 Tokens（以千为单位），以及以美元估算的智能体成本。 我们在所有 Harness 上统一采用提供商官方网站发布的相同模型特定价格。 输入成本利用可用的计数器，将普通输入、缓存读取和缓存写入分开计算。 未明确指定的缓存部分按普通输入费率计价。 输出成本包含已记录的推理 Tokens，但不会重复计入。 总成本为输入成本加输出成本，并在有有效记录用量的运行上取平均值。 这些是标准化的 Token 成本估算值，而非历史账单。 评审调用、被放弃的执行、支付手续费、存储以及工具费用不在其涵盖范围内。

paragraphs.en: All 3,420 targeted cells have a final combined score, with nonempty binary verdict vectors for both layers. Each model–Harness block contains 95 runs; each Harness therefore contributes 855 and each model 380. Across the population, 14,979 of 20,016 Agent items pass (74.8%), compared with 19,242 of 28,188 Harness items (68.3%). The mean per-run scores are 72.9% for the Agent layer and 67.9% for the Harness layer, producing a mean 50/50 score of 70.4. These continuous scores differ substantially from all-criteria success. A total of 1,351 runs (39.5%) satisfy every Agent criterion, whereas only 286 (8.4%) satisfy every criterion in both layers.
paragraphs.zh: 全部 3,420 个目标单元格均有最终综合得分，且两个层都具备非空的二元判定向量。 每个模型–Harness 区块包含 95 次运行；因此每个 Harness 贡献 855 个，每个模型贡献 380 个。 在总体中，20,016 个智能体条目中有 14,979 个通过（74.8%），相比之下 28,188 个 Harness 条目中有 19,242 个通过（68.3%）。 每次运行的平均得分为：智能体层 72.9%，Harness 层 67.9%，由此得到 50/50 平均分为 70.4。 这些连续得分与全标准通过的情况存在显著差异。 共有 1,351 次运行（39.5%）满足所有智能体标准，而仅有 286 次运行（8.4%）同时满足两个层的所有标准。

paragraphs.en: Table 6 gives the primary harness comparison over all model–task cells per harness. Table 5.3 reports the complete numerical comparison, including all nine fixed-model blocks.
